messages:
Leigh Harper: Quick sync — we need an onboarding runbook for ISV/tooling connectors (LangChain/LlamaIndex + orchestrators/gateways) that covers marketplace listing, HW partner validation, and a joint announcement path. Can we sketch owners and deadlines?
Ana Patel: +1. I can own the marketplace listing checklist. timeline?
Samir Khan: I can own the connector certification tests (compat + perf). suggest 2-week sprint for initial smoke tests.
Evan Liu: I’ll handle the HW partner validation matrix (quantized model support, memory footprint, perf baselines). Need sample workloads from partners.
Priya Reddy: I’ll coordinate the announcement (PR/blog/demo). Proposed embargo week: May 15 — gives us 3 weeks to finalize docs.
Leigh Harper: Owners noted. High-level checklist to include: compatibility tests, security review, sample app + quickstart, marketplace metadata, joint press materials, partner-run demo slot, SI enablement pack.
Ana Patel: Marketplace checklist draft: product name, short/long desc, pricing tier, supported regions, required infra (dedicated/private), model variants, sample request payloads, screenshots, partner logos, DOIs for certs.
Samir Khan: For cert tests:
```
- unit: inference correctness vs baseline
- perf: p95 latency under target load (2k tokens/session)
- stability: 24h soak test + mem leak monitor
- kv-cache correctness (for chat flows)
```
Evan Liu: HW validation snippet: target configs we run: A100-80GB, H100-80GB, RTX6000-48GB. test workloads: long-context summarization (32k), multi-turn chat (8k).
Priya Reddy: Announcement playbook: embargo date, joint quotes from partner BD and Redwood, 1 blog, 1 product update, optional webinar with partner SI track. Who drafts the copy? Ana or me?
Ana Patel: I can draft marketplace copy + quickstart. Priya can draft blog + PR. Leigh to review final.
Leigh Harper: DevRel needs a sample app that shows orchestration -> gateway -> Redwood runtime with fallback to hosted model. Evan/Samir can pair on that.
Samir Khan: Will do. DevRel Bot, queue a PR template for connector repos?
DevRel Bot: Created issue template: "ISV Connector Cert". Link: https://git.internal/rw/issues/8421 :robot_face:
Evan Liu: One technical gotcha: orchestration tools often require streaming function hooks; ensure our SDK sample shows streaming + tool-calling fallback.
Priya Reddy: Also include a timeline in runbook: Week 0: partner kickoff, Week 1: smoke + docs, Week 2: perf + security, Week 3: final sign-off + marketing assets.
Leigh Harper: Deadline-wise — if we want May 15 embargo, partners need kickoff this week. Assign: Ana (marketplace + quickstart) due in 5 working days, Samir (tests + test reports) in 10 days, Evan (HW validation + perf numbers) in 10 days, Priya (announcement draft) in 12 days.
Ana Patel: Acked. I’ll post checklist link and starter metadata in this thread.
Samir Khan: Will put initial smoke test results in CI and share pass/fail matrix.
Evan Liu: Will request partner images and confirm hardware slots.
Priya Reddy: I’ll prepare a draft PR and share with partners and Leigh for review.
Leigh Harper: Nice. Last item — legal/security: Priya loop in security for data handling & partner SLAs. Samir, please attach security test logs.
Samir Khan: Will attach.
Ana Patel: Link to the working doc: https://docs.internal/rw/partnerships/isv-orch-runbook (will post update shortly) :spiral_notepad:
Priya Reddy: Putting a calendar invite for a 30m sync tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Leigh Harper: Thanks all. If we hit blockers, ping me and @Priya. :thumbsup:
